scenes.title: $5,000 AT *22%*
scenes.sub: near the current US average APR

captions.t: If you only pay the minimum on your credit card, this is what happens.
Say you owe five thousand dollars at about twenty-two percent interest. That's close to the US average right now.
If you pay only the minimum, it takes about nineteen years to pay it off.
And you pay over eight thousand dollars in interest. More than the original debt.
Pay two hundred a month instead, and you're done in under three years, with about eighteen hundred in interest.
The minimum payment is designed to keep you paying. Follow to keep more of your money.
